_guide: Small extras: campfire talks on long breaks, coming back to a world, the sky of the day, and star regions.
campfire: lines for the long break, with {crew} and {other} (two people), {recent} (the last world you found) and {place}
(a place on it). campfire_alone: the same when it's just you. return: when you travel back to a world, with {world},
{days} (days since you were there), {crew}, and camped: true if you camped there before.
skies: one is today's sky, the same for everyone on the same day. id, ic, name, text (what you see).
regions: parts of space that open with hours studied. id, name, hours, desc, and bias (all optional):
heat (added, -0.3 to 0.3), mild (0 to 1: pulls heat toward Earth-like), water and life (multiplied), giant (chance of a giant, 0 to 1), age (added),
types (planet type weights multiplied, like { "Crystal": 4 }), fam (colour family weights added, see js/world/paint.js),
rare: true (better odds of rare worlds).

campfire: {Crew} pokes the fire and says {recent} was the strangest place so far. {Other} says that about every place.
{Crew} and {other} argue about whether {place} had a better view than the last one. The fire wins the argument.
Somebody starts a song about {recent}. {Other} knows all the words already, somehow.
{Crew} tells {other} what {crew.they} {crew:wants|want} to find next. {Other} says {other.they} just {other:wants|want} more of this.
{Crew} roasts something over the fire. Nobody is sure what it is. Everyone has seconds.
{Other} falls asleep against {crew}'s shoulder. {Crew} doesn't move for an hour.

campfire.text: {Crew} and {other} sit quietly for a long time. That's the kind of friends they are now.
{Crew} finally asks {other} about {other.their} {other.gear}. It's a long story, and a good one.
{Crew} tells the scariest story {crew.they} {crew:knows|know}. {Other} laughs all the way through it.

campfire_alone: Just you, a small fire and the sound of the {ship}'s engines cooling. You write a few lines about {recent}.
You make tea, sit by the fire and count the worlds so far. It's a good number.
The fire crackles. You think about {place}, and about where to go next. No hurry.
return: Back on {world}, {days} days later. It looks just the same, which is exactly what you hoped.
{Crew} is first down the ramp. "It missed us," {crew.they} {crew:says|say}. Maybe it did.
Coming back to {world} after {days} days feels like coming home. The view over the {biome} hasn't changed a bit. You have.
Since you were last here, the light over the {biome} has turned [gold|silver|a soft blue|a deeper green].

return.text: Your old campfire ring is still there on {world}. Someone, or something, has left a smooth stone in the middle.
Only a day away, and {world} already feels different. {Crew} says it's the light.
{days} days is a long time. {World} has kept your footprints, half-filled with dust, like it was saving them.

skies.name: a meteor shower
skies.text: Hundreds of meteors streak across the sky, one after another. Everybody makes a wish. Nobody says what.

skies.name: an aurora
skies.text: Curtains of green and violet light ripple across the whole sky, slow and silent, for hours.

skies.name: a comet
skies.text: A comet hangs in the sky, its tail stretched halfway across the stars, as if it stopped to look around.

skies.name: an eclipse
skies.text: A moon slides in front of the sun. Everything goes quiet and blue for a few long minutes.

skies.name: a planet alignment
skies.text: Five planets line up in a perfect row across the sky, like beads on a string.

skies.name: a glowing nebula
skies.text: A nebula is rising tonight: a cloud of pink and gold, big enough to hold a thousand suns.

skies.name: a double rainbow
skies.text: Rain and sun at the same time, and two rainbows, one inside the other.

skies.name: a green flash
skies.text: Just as the sun sets, the last sliver of it flashes bright green. Blink and you'd miss it. You don't.

skies.name: a moonbow
skies.text: A pale rainbow made of moonlight arches over the horizon. It looks like it's made of silver.

skies.name: falling stars
skies.text: Every few minutes another falling star, as if the sky is shaking out its pockets.

skies.name: zodiacal light
skies.text: A faint cone of light rises from the horizon after sunset: sunlight on dust between the planets.

skies.name: a perfectly clear sky
skies.text: Not one cloud, not one light on the ground. More stars than anyone aboard has ever seen at once.

regions.name: The Near Reaches
regions.desc: Where every voyage starts. A little of everything.

regions.name: The Glass Nebula
regions.desc: Crystal worlds and glittering storms, in shades of violet and pink.

regions.name: The Quiet Belt
regions.desc: Cold, old, peaceful worlds where nothing is in a hurry.

regions.name: The Green Drift
regions.desc: Wet, warm and alive. Gardens, jungles and seas everywhere.

regions.name: The Ember Reach
regions.desc: Close to young, hot stars. Lava, deserts and fire-coloured skies.

regions.name: The Far Dark
regions.desc: The edge of the map. Strange, lonely, rare worlds.
